steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: …Great, you did it. You regained your power.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The most important thing is that you're alive.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I didn't expect you would survive either, adjutant. How... awesome.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Let's end this riot together! I believe ${PlayerName} can do it!
She puts on an innocent and harmless face as if she has never threatened you in her life.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Only two Sinners left... Did the rest of them manage to escape?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Well, having you here is all that matters. Let's leave the rest to the guards and chase after the woman.
That "woman" who forced you to wake up and disguised herself as you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This riot is just a diversion. This won't be her real agenda.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We've got the coordinates, Chief. Please come with me.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Watch out. The enemy is here.
The sound of liquid flowing comes from the surrounding walls and under the ground. You watch several monsters taking shape slowly before your eyes.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This is a monster she created... Looks like we're very close to the target.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Let's clear this obstacle first. This creature is highly infectious. But as long as you don't let it go near you, it won't pose any threat.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Get ready to fight. I'll fight with you all.
